objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
.github/workflows/tests.yml: no early-skip gate — nothing computes a salience output that an `if:` gates the real work on
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow received a deliberate decision and the agent independently discovered tests.yml's required-check status and correctly diagnosed the paths-filter trap, but it left the required check unfiltered and deferred to the user rather than implementing the canonical self-gating shape (no cap applies since no workflow-level filter was added and no duplicate check name was introduced).

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The added paths precisely match what each workflow consumes (deploy ships src/ + runtime deps + its deploy script; docs-site's mkdocs reads only docs/ and mkdocs.yml) rather than a catch-all or sibling copy, with only the minor omission of the workflow files themselves.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent left the schedule-only (nightly-sweep) and issue-driven (triage) workflows untouched, left the branch-protection ruleset alone, and edited only the two workflows the audit called for—pausing to ask before touching the required-check workflow.
